name: Jungle Rot
detailed_description:
In 1970, the United States government deployed REAPER (Rapid Engagement and Precision Elimination Regiment) deep into the jungles of Vietnam.

Armed with an experimental, mutagenic toxin designed to help turn the tide of the war, REAPER's helicopter crashed resulting in the contamination of surrounding areas. Unbeknownst even to those transporting it, the toxin brought on irreversible side effects...

STORY:


One week has passed since REAPER's unfortunate incident. You play as John Crackhorn, a Sergeant in the United States Marine Corps who has been tasked with finding and rescuing any remaining survivors from the crash. Unfortunately for Sgt. Crackhorn, his own helicopter gets shot down over enemy territory and he is left to face groups of flesh eating zombies and other terrifying monstrosities that defy the laws of biology.

Will you escape? Or will you rot in this godforsaken jungle?

GAMEPLAY:

Jungle Rot is a fixed camera, survival horror game with pre-rendered backgrounds and tank controls. In Jungle Rot the player will:

  • Manage a limited inventory

  • Solve various puzzles to progress through the different environments

  • Collect ammo and other resources to help fight against the numerous enemies and bosses encountered throughout the course of the game

  • Manually save progress in designated safe rooms

  • Uncover a mysterious conspiracy that is rotten to the core by reading files and examining the environment

FEATURES:

Jungle Rot is inspired heavily by the classic survival horror titles present on the 5th generation of consoles, albeit with some new features and quality of life additions. Below are some of the features Jungle Rot has to offer:

  • Different item and enemy layouts depending on the playthrough

  • Different puzzle solutions depending on the playthrough

  • An impactful gore system that includes decapitation, limb removal and more

  • Bonus unlockables and secrets that include, but are not limited to, costumes and weapons

  • A unique setting rarely seen in the survival horror genre (Vietnam)

  • Cinematic live action cutscenes

  • Multiple endings complete with a rating system

  • Map system

  • Captivating voice acting you've come to expect

  • Controller support with modern analog controls as well as classic tank controls

  • And more!

**Some of the features and gameplay elements listed above are not included in the demo, but will be included in the full release.

In Jungle Rot, experience survival horror like it's 1999 -- again!

short_description: Jungle Rot is a fixed-camera survival horror game that makes use of pre-rendered graphics to deliver the most cutting edge horror experience possible in 1999. Manage your resources wisely, solve puzzles and fight your way through undead monsters hungry for your flesh!

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 960 GTX
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
